Iris W: Heads-up: I'm reviewing the Optimize Toolkit docs and found a cluster of issues across snippets and links: Ruby SDK shows `kv_prefetch: true` (deprecated), C# quickstart still references `qprofile-old` anchor, and the migration page lacks a tiny diagnostic to validate prefetch is active.

Ben C: Thanks Iris. I can handle the Ruby snippet. We moved to `prefetch: { mode: "automatic" }` across SDKs. I'll replace the boolean and add a one-line comment `# hosted default`.

Margo S: For the C# quickstart link, rather than a direct anchor I prefer pointing to the stable alias `https://docs.redwood.ai/qprofiles/latest` — that avoids future 404s. Also noticed the quickstart uses `batching: auto` which our SDK removed last quarter. Suggest explicit `batch_size: 16` in quickstart and a more advanced C# snippet showing token-based batching.

Iris W: Agreed. Plan: 1) quickstart -> explicit `batch_size: 16` + stable qprofiles alias, 2) Ruby + C# snippets -> replace `kv_prefetch: true` with `prefetch.mode: automatic` and add small note for Dedicated users to use `manual`, 3) add a Diagnostic subsection to migration guide with curl/jq checks for prefetch metadata and token-count comparison.

Ben C: I'll push the Ruby change. Quick patch snippet: 
```ruby
# quickstart (hosted default)
client.config.prefetch = { mode: 'automatic' } # tune for dedicated
```
Also add a tiny test-case to `tests/snippets/test_ruby_prefetch.rb`.

Tao R: I'll draft the diagnostic. Suggest two checks: a trace call to inspect `.meta.prefetch.mode`, and a tokenization count diff to detect tokenizer variance after quantization. Example pseudo: 
```bash
# check prefetch mode
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-opt-13b-q8","input":"long prefix...","trace":true}' | jq '.meta.prefetch.mode'

# tokenization compare (pseudo)
echo "long prefix..." | tokenizer --model rwd-opt-13b | wc -w
echo "long prefix..." | tokenizer --model rwd-opt-13b-q8 | wc -w
```
If token counts differ, recommend switching to `max_tokens` batching or lowering `batch_size`.

Margo S: Good. Also add a short troubleshooting note: when switching to q8/q4 customers have seen increased truncation of short prefixes — call out `kv cache block size` and recommend running the diagnostic above. We'll include a one-liner for CS to copy into replies.

Iris W: One more: update `redirects.yaml` request ticket REDWOOD-999 to add a redirect from `/optimize/quant_profiles/qprofile-old` -> `/qprofiles/latest`. I'll file that after PRs. Please add DOCS ticket IDs to PR descriptions (DOCS-821 for quickstart + DOCS-822 for migration diag).
